pre.name: scope
pre.prompt: Read the hardened plan and the execution summary. Identify the changed files and the acceptance criteria they map to. Write a brief scope note to scope.md.

team.name: acceptance
team.prompt: Independently verify each acceptance criterion against the implementation and its evidence. Report any criterion that is not implemented or not evidenced. Write findings to acceptance.md.

team.name: regression
team.prompt: Run the repository's full test suite and the plan's broader verification. Report any regression or failure. Write findings to regression.md.

team.name: review
team.prompt: Review the diff for correctness, scope drift, and missing work. Report findings at confidence 60 or higher. Write findings to review.md.

post.name: synthesize
post.prompt: Synthesize acceptance.md, regression.md, and review.md into verification.md. State PASS or FAIL with evidence. Do not lower the bar to make it pass.
